captions.text: [Paired hunter calls, right]
| Rippling lights run along a long shape in the warm passage. It has seen your lamp. Dim it, or climb to the pale cool ledges.
| [Paired hunter calls, right]
Lamp off · running dark. Light hunters see you less; you see less.
| The stalker coils back into the warm passage; its lights slow.
[Hunter calls fade]
| The stalker stops at the edge of the cool water and will not follow.
| [Hunter calls fade]
[Paired hunter calls, behind]
| A long shape in the warm passage turns its head toward your noise. Slow down, dim your lamp or leave the warm water.
| [Paired hunter calls, behind]
